αἰσθάνομαι: to perceive, apprehend by the senses, to see, hear, feel
αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
βεβαιόω: to make firm, confirm, establish, secure, warrant, make good
βουλεύω: to take counsel, deliberate, concert measures
δεξιόομαι: to greet with the right hand, welcome, greet
δηλέομαι: to hurt, do a mischief to
διίημι: drive, thrust through (a weapon); disband (an army)
διαπεραίνω: to bring to a conclusion, discuss thoroughly
διαπράσσω: to pass over; bring about, accomplish
διεργάζομαι: to make an end of, kill, destroy
δουλόω: to make a slave of, enslave
εἰκάζω: to make like to, represent by a likeness, portray
εἰσοικίζω: to bring in as a settler
εἰσοράω: to look into, look upon, view, behold
εἰσφέρω: to bring in, to propose (a question, a law), to pay tax (εἰσφορά)
εὔχομαι: to pray, offer prayers, pay one’s vows, make a vow
θεάομαι: to look on, gaze at, view, behold
θερίζω: to do summer-work, to mow, reap
καταλύω: to put down, destroy; settle (disputes); lodge, rest
καταξαίνω: to card; shred; wear down, waste away
καταπαύω: to lay to rest, put an end to
κατεργάζομαι: to effect by labour, to achieve, accomplish
κείρω: to cut short, shear (hair); ravage, destroy
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
κτάομαι: to procure for oneself, to get, gain, acquire
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
λανθάνω: to escape notice, to be unknown, unseen, unnoticed
μέμφομαι: to blame, censure, find fault with
μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
μεθορμίζω: to remove from one anchorage to another
μειλίσσω: to make mild, to appease, propitiate
μεταβάλλω: to throw into a different position, to turn quickly
μεταπέμπω: to send after, send for, summon
παρατάσσω: to place side by side, draw up in battle-order
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
περιγίγνομαι: to be superior to; to survive
πλέκω: to plait, twine, twist, weave, braid
πορίζω: to carry: to bring about, to furnish, provide, supply, procure, cause
προαιρέω: to bring forth; (mid.) to choose, to prefer
προσγίγνομαι: to come in addition, to accrue, to support
προσκομίζω: to carry, convey; mid. bring with one, bring home
προσολοφύρομαι: to wail to, vent one’s griefs to
προσποιέω: to make over to; mid. procure, pretend
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
προστρέπω: to turn towards a god, to approach with prayer, supplicate
προφυλάσσω: to keep guard before, to guard
σπένδω: to pour a libation, (mid.) to make a treaty
στηρίζω: to make fast, prop, fix, set
στρατεύω: to serve in war, serve as a soldier, do military service, take the field, march
στρατοπεδεύω: to encamp, bivouac, take up a position
συλλογίζομαι: to collect and bring at once before the mind, to compute fully, sum up
συμβάλλω: to throw together; come together; collect, contract, contribute
συμφράζομαι: to join in considering, to take counsel with
συνάπτω: to tie, join together, meet in battle
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
τιμάω: to honor; to value something at a price (gen.)
τιμωρέω: to seek, exact vengeance; help to retaliate
φαίνω: to bring to light, make to appear
φυλάσσω: to keep watch and ward, keep guard
ψηφίζω: (mid.) to vote; (act.) to count with pebbles
ἀίσσω: to move with a quick shooting motion, to shoot, dart, glance
ἀνέχω: to hold up; (mid.) endure, put up with
ἀναίνομαι: to reject with contempt, turn one’s back on, spurn
ἀνακαλέω: call on, invoke; call back, recall
ἀνακρούω: to push back, stop short, check
ἀναπαύω: to make to cease, to stop
ἀνασκοπέω: to look at narrowly, examine well
ἀντιτάσσω: to set opposite to, range in battle against
ἀπεχθάνομαι: to be hated, incur hatred, be roused to hatred
ἀπογίγνομαι: to be away from, have no part in
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell
ἀποκρίνω: to separate, set apart; mid. answer
ἀποκρύπτω: to hide from, keep hidden from
ἀπολογέομαι: to speak in defence, defend oneself
ἀπονίναμαι: have the use or enjoyment of a thing
ἀρέσκω: (to make good, make up), to please
ἀσπάζομαι: to welcome kindly, bid welcome, greet
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄγαμαι: to wonder, be astonished; be envious
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch
ἐγγίγνομαι: to be born or bred in; be innate, be native
ἐγχειρίζω: to put into one’s hands, entrust
ἐκδέχομαι: to receive, to take over (succeed on the throne, an argument)
ἐνορμίζω: to bring a ship to land
ἐντύνω: to equip, deck out, get ready
ἐξαλείφω: to plaster over; to wipe out, obliterate
ἐξαμύνομαι: to ward off from oneself, drive away
ἐξηγέομαι: to be leader of; dictate, interpret, explain
ἐπεισάγω: to bring in besides, to bring in
ἐπιγίγνομαι: to be born after, come into being after
ἐπιλέγω: say in connexion with; to choose; to think over
ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι: to remember, think of; to mention
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw
ἔχω: have, hold; be able; (+ adv.) be; (mid.) cling to, be next to (+ gen.)
ἱδρύω: to make to sit down, to seat
ἱκνέομαι: to come, reach, approach; to supplicate, beseech; to befit
ὁρμίζω: to bring to a safe anchorage, bring into harbour, to moor, anchor
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὑπερβάλλω: to throw over; outdo, surpass, postpone
ὑποβάλλω: throw, put, lay under; bring in as one’s own
ὑποδέω: to bind under: put shoes on
ὑποζεύγνυμι: to yoke under, put under the yoke
ὑφαιρέω: (lit. to seize underneath), take away, steal, take gradually, deduct
ὠθέω: to thrust, push, shove, force onwards
